title: "Peatlands and Torbiere"

## Alto Appennino Modenese

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(leaflet)

leaflet(
  options = leafletOptions(
    zoomControl = FALSE
  )
) |>

  addTiles(
    attribution = "&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"
  ) |>

  # Approximate footprint of the Alto Appennino Modenese
  addPolygons(
    lng = c(
      10.48, 10.50, 10.54, 10.58, 10.62,
      10.67, 10.72, 10.77, 10.82, 10.83,
      10.81, 10.77, 10.73, 10.68, 10.63,
      10.58, 10.53, 10.49
    ),
    lat = c(
      44.23, 44.24, 44.22, 44.20, 44.21,
      44.23, 44.23, 44.22, 44.20, 44.18,
      44.16, 44.14, 44.13, 44.12, 44.12,
      44.13, 44.15, 44.18
    ),
    color = "#163B32",
    weight = 2,
    fillColor = "#DCD0FF",
    fillOpacity = 0.35
  ) |>

  # Park label
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = 10.66,
    lat = 44.18,
    label = "Parco dell'Alto Appennino Modenese",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "center",
      textOnly = TRUE,
      className = "study-label"
    )
  ) |>

  fitBounds(
    lng1 = 10.35,
    lat1 = 44.05,
    lng2 = 11.55,
    lat2 = 44.82
  ) |>

  addScaleBar(
    position = "bottomleft",
    options = scaleBarOptions(
      imperial = FALSE
    )
  )
```
## Corveen Bog, County Donegal

```{r}
#| echo: false

library(leaflet)

leaflet(
  options = leafletOptions(
    zoomControl = FALSE
  )
) |>

  addTiles(
    attribution = "&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors"
  ) |>

  # Approximate footprint of Corveen Bog
  addPolygons(
    lng = c(
      -8.25, -8.23, -8.20, -8.17, -8.15,
      -8.14, -8.16, -8.19, -8.22, -8.25
    ),
    lat = c(
      55.09, 55.11, 55.12, 55.11, 55.09,
      55.07, 55.06, 55.07, 55.08, 55.09
    ),
    color = "#163B32",
    weight = 2,
    fillColor = "#DCD0FF",
    fillOpacity = 0.35
  ) |>

  # Corveen Bog label
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = -8.205,
    lat = 55.091,
    label = "Corveen Bog",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "center",
      textOnly = TRUE,
      className = "study-label"
    )
  ) |>

  # Gortahork
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = -8.225,
    lat = 55.065,
    label = "Gortahork",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "bottom",
      textOnly = TRUE,
      className = "city-label"
    )
  ) |>

  # Bunbeg
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = -8.300,
    lat = 55.070,
    label = "Bunbeg",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "left",
      textOnly = TRUE,
      className = "city-label"
    )
  ) |>

  # Donegal
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    lng = -8.110,
    lat = 54.654,
    label = "Donegal",
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "right",
      textOnly = TRUE,
      className = "city-label"
    )
  ) |>

  fitBounds(
    lng1 = -8.45,
    lat1 = 54.95,
    lng2 = -7.90,
    lat2 = 55.20
  ) |>

  addScaleBar(
    position = "bottomleft",
    options = scaleBarOptions(
      imperial = FALSE
    )
  )
```
